name: opsphere
description: DevOps and SRE intelligence for ChatGPT Codex — search Datadog logs, triage outages, diagnose CI/CD pipelines, check deployments, and manage AWS, Kubernetes, GitHub, Jira, Sentry, and Cloudflare through a secure remote MCP gateway.

interface.shortDescription: DevOps & SRE MCP for Codex — Datadog, outages, CI/CD, AWS, K8s & deploys
interface.longDescription: Opsphere connects ChatGPT Codex to your operational stack through a secure remote MCP gateway. Onboarding walks you through plan status, work context, and your first integration. Then use guided skills to investigate site-down incidents and outages, run DNS/HTTP/TLS endpoint health checks, diagnose failed GitHub Actions and Bitbucket pipelines, search Datadog logs and errors, check Vercel and multi-platform deployment status, triage Sentry issues and Jira tickets, and write structured post-mortems. Configure Datadog, AWS, GitHub, Cloudflare, Jira, Sentry, Bitbucket, and more from chat — credentials stay encrypted on the gateway. Community plan with free trial; same operational tools as the Opsphere Cursor plugin.
defaultPrompt: @plan-and-usage check my account and summarize my plan in plain language
@set-work-context help me describe my stack, environments, and tools
@configure-integration guide me through connecting Datadog, AWS, or GitHub
